page_label: 说　明　书 8/8 页

paragraphs.zh: 速调整为280转/h，控温滴加10％盐酸水溶液调节PH为2重结晶后降温析晶得淡黄色固体，烘干得262.1g环磺酮，含量95％。
paragraphs.en: ... speed was adjusted to 280 revolutions/h; 10% aqueous hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the pH to 2; after recrystallisation the temperature was lowered to crystallise out a pale yellow solid, and drying gave 262.1 g of tembotrione, content 95%.
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph CONTINUES FROM p09 and only its printed tail appears on this page, so the merge must not read it as a whole paragraph. No [0053] marker is printed here; the text starts flush at the top of the body with no marker and no indent. Its first character is the tail of a word broken across the page boundary, the word having begun on p09, which is why the English begins mid-sentence with an ellipsis; on this page that word ends as 'speed was adjusted to 280 revolutions/h'. The pH is printed here with capital P capital H, not the lower-case pH used in the claims; transcribed as printed. The clause runs on with no punctuation between 'adjust the pH to 2' and 'recrystallise', exactly as printed, so the English keeps them in one sentence rather than inventing a break.

paragraphs.zh: 目标产品环磺酮核磁参数如下：1HNMR(CDCl3)，δ2.12(m，2H)
paragraphs.en: The NMR parameters of the target product tembotrione are as follows: 1H NMR (CDCl3), delta 2.12 (m, 2H)
paragraphs.notes: Characterisation datum. The peak list is split across the paragraph break: [0054] carries the solvent and the FIRST peak only, and [0055] carries the remaining eight peaks. [0054] ends with no closing punctuation, mid-list. Printed as '1HNMR(CDCl3)' with no space, no field strength and no ppm unit; the nucleus '1H' and the '3' of CDCl3 are both set full size, not subscripted or superscripted, as printed. The scan renders the lower-case 'l' of CDCl3 with very nearly the same glyph as the digit 1, so on the pixels alone it reads 'CDC13'; the text layer gives CDCl3 and that reading is used. No digit was altered anywhere in the peak list.

Continuation of the peak list begun in [0054]; a paragraph marker is printed, but chemically this is one datum with [0054]. Transcribed exactly as printed, peaks in printed order, nothing normalised and nothing reordered. Two things printed here are unusual and are left as printed: (1) the multiplicity of the 3.25 peak is a CAPITAL S, where every other multiplicity letter on the page is lower case (t, t, q, s, d, d, s) and where the analogous 3H singlet is conventionally written s; (2) the last three proton counts are written 'H', not '1H', unlike the 2H and 3H counts earlier in the list. Proton count: the printed peaks sum to 2+2+2+3+2+2+1+1+1 = 16, which is exactly the 16 hydrogens of tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S. Every signal is accounted for: 2.12, 2.47 and 2.81 (2H each) are the three cyclohexane-1,3-dione methylenes, 3.25 (3H) the sulfonyl methyl, 4.01 (2H, quartet from three-bond H-F coupling) the OCH2CF3 methylene, 5.21 (2H) the benzylic ArCH2O methylene, 7.33 and 8.12 (1H each) the only two aromatic protons the ring retains once it bears Cl, SO2CH3 and CH2OCH2CF3, and 15.37 (1H) the enol OH. An earlier reading of this page called the list inconsistent with the product; that reading misidentified the product and has been withdrawn on the record in discrepancies, entry 1.

paragraphs.zh: 本领域普通技术人员可以理解：以上所述仅为本发明的优选实施例而已，并不用于限制本发明，尽管参照前述实施例对本发明进行了详细的说明，对于本领域的技术人员来说，其依然可以对前述各实施例记载的技术方案进行修改，或者对其中部分技术特征进行等同替换。凡在本发明的精神和原则之内，所作的任何修改、等同替换、改进等，均应包含在本发明的保护范围之内。
paragraphs.en: Those of ordinary skill in the art will understand that the foregoing is merely a preferred embodiment of the present invention and is not intended to limit the present invention. Although the present invention has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, a person skilled in the art may still modify the technical solutions recorded in each of the foregoing embodiments, or make equivalent substitutions for some of the technical features therein. Any modification, equivalent substitution, improvement and the like made within the spirit and principles of the present invention shall be included within the scope of protection of the present invention.
paragraphs.notes: Closing boilerplate, the standard Chinese patent disclaimer paragraph. It carries no chemistry, no reagent and no quantity, and is the last paragraph of the description. Print wraps joined with no separator; the Chinese enumeration commas in the final sentence are kept as printed in the zh field.

discrepancies.what: FIRST READING WITHDRAWN / SECOND READING ADOPTED. First reading: the 1H NMR list at [0054] and [0055] appeared inconsistent with the product as named, because its peaks sum to 16 protons, only two aromatic doublets are printed, and it carries a 2H quartet at 4.01 and a 2H singlet at 5.21. That reading rested entirely on taking the product name to mean sulcotrione (C14H13ClO5S, MW 328.77, 13 hydrogens, three aromatic protons, no OCH2CF3), which is the wrong compound: sulcotrione is a different herbicide with a different Chinese name. Second reading: the product is tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, which has exactly 16 hydrogens, and every feature called impossible under the first reading is a feature tembotrione has - 4.01 (q, 2H) the OCH2CF3 methylene with its three-bond H-F coupling, 5.21 (s, 2H) the benzylic ArCH2O methylene, and only two aromatic protons because the ring already bears Cl, SO2CH3 and CH2OCH2CF3. The pattern identified in the first reading as 'a trifluoroethoxymethyl analogue' is the compound this patent is about. Outcome: the peak list IS consistent with the named product and there is no discrepancy here. Entry kept, not deleted, so the misreading and its correction stay on the record.
discrepancies.drawing_says: No drawing on this page, and no structural formula anywhere on p10, so p10 alone cannot fix the identity of the product. The identifiers that do fix it are printed on p03, which this pass could not see: [0003] CAS 335104-84-2, [0004] molecular formula C17H16ClF3O6S, [0005] molecular weight 440.88, and the structure drawn at [0007] and [0008], namely 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl cyclohexane-1,3-dione. All four are tembotrione. That the correction needed a page outside this one is the reason the first reading is recorded rather than quietly dropped: a per-page pass can misidentify a product named only by its Chinese common name.
discrepancies.text_says: The prose names the target product by its Chinese common name, in the yield line of [0053] and again in [0054], and gives 1H NMR (CDCl3): 2.12 (m, 2H), 2.47 (t, 2H), 2.81 (t, 2H), 3.25 (S, 3H), 4.01 (q, 2H), 5.21 (s, 2H), 7.33 (d, H), 8.12 (d, H), 15.37 (s, H). Rendered into English that name is tembotrione, not sulcotrione (a different herbicide) and not mesotrione (a third).

discrepancies.what: The pH of the acid adjustment is printed with capital letters as PH in the tail of [0053] on this page, while the claims print it lower case as pH.
discrepancies.text_says: The [0053] tail reads 'adjust the PH to 2' with capital P capital H, in the clause about dropwise addition of 10% aqueous hydrochloric acid under temperature control.
